## About this playbook

High quality analysis is essential for effective decision-making, operational management and
service improvement. This playbook explains how NHSBSA analysis should be commissioned, produced,
assured and used to ensure a consistent approach across the organisation.

It provides practical guidance for everyone involved in analytical work, including directors,
commissioners, users, analysts, analytical assurers and third-party suppliers.

It applies to all analysis and datasets used or produced by the NHSBSA, whether for internal
purposes, external publication, or sharing with sponsors and partners.

## Who should use it

| Role | Responsibility |
|------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| [Analyst](guidance/06-roles/analyst.qmd) | Plans, produces, documents and quality assures analysis. |
| [Commissioner](guidance/06-roles/commissioner.qmd) | Defines the business need, intended use and impact of the analysis. |
| [Critical friend (assurer)](guidance/06-roles/critical-friend.qmd) | Provides independent review and challenge. |
| [Analysis Senior Responsible Officer](guidance/06-roles/analysis-senior-responsible-officer.qmd) | Provides oversight and approval for Business Critical analysis. |
| Director or Head of Service | Ensures appropriate governance and oversight of analytical work. |

: The roles that use the playbook, and what each is responsible for
